classification: prospective bounded amendment after official page-100 preflight; before archive pagination or notice-detail collection
reason: The official notice API reports 4,216 records and pageSize 100. The fixed first-page response covers only 2026-04-23 through 2026-10-28, but contains HS300 routine and temporary adjustment notices. One page cannot establish historical coverage.

amended_method.listing: Retain the already frozen page 1 response and query official pages 2 through 43 with the identical POST schema and rows=100; require page totals to remain 4,216 and verify every item ID is unique. Do not silently stop early.
amended_method.record_selection: Select every listing row whose title contains 沪深300, 沪深 300, 000300, or CSI 300, plus all index-adjustment rows in the 2018-01-02 to 2026-10-27 publication window for a completeness cross-check.
amended_method.details: Fetch the official queryAnnouncementById endpoint once for each unique HS300-related listing ID. Preserve the complete JSON response. Download every official enclosure linked by those details and hash the raw bytes.
amended_method.verification: Report listing publication-date coverage, gaps, routine and temporary adjustment counts, unique IDs, duplicate/missing pages, attachment availability, and effective dates parsed verbatim from official content/attachments.

limitations: The paginated archive may change during collection; capture per-page totals, ranges and timestamps, and fail completeness if IDs or totals are inconsistent.
A complete publication archive is not sufficient by itself: effective dates and every event must be present in details/attachments.
Do not claim PIT reconstruction until every adjustment event and seed membership across the target window has been independently reconciled.
prohibited: No alpha mining or return backtest.
No production data or membership write, no cache mutation, and no third-party membership substitution.
